title: Ask Koutsi
subtitle: Your coach, with your training data in front of it.
deleteBody: The whole thread goes, including everything you wrote. This cannot be undone.
boundary: Koutsi is a coach, not a clinician. For anything about symptoms, injury, illness or medication, talk to a doctor.

empty.greeting: What would you like to ask?
empty.hint: Koutsi can look at your activities, plan, goals and fitness numbers to answer.

status.queued: Koutsi is finishing something else — your question is next…

noOffer: Koutsi could not draft this change, so there is nothing to accept. Ask again, or edit your plan yourself.

errors.busy: Koutsi was busy with other work and couldn't get to this in time. Try again in a moment.
errors.tools_unsupported: Your AI model can't use the tools Koutsi needs to look at your data.
errors.no_answer: Your AI model didn't return an answer. Try again.
errors.upstream: The AI server had a problem answering. Try again in a moment.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach the AI server. Check it's running, then try again.
errors.stalled: This answer stopped partway through. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong answering this. Try again.

unavailable.disabledBody: Koutsi can only chat when it's allowed to look things up in your data. Turn on the agentic coach in your profile to use this.
unavailable.toolsTitle: Your AI model can't do this
unavailable.toolsBody: Chatting needs a model that can call tools, so Koutsi can go and read your activities, plan and fitness numbers. The model you've selected can't. Pick a different model in your AI settings.

budget.spentBody: More become available as the day rolls on.
budget.conversationFullBody: Start a new one to carry on — Koutsi won't lose track of your training, it looks it up fresh each time.
budget.turnInFlight: Koutsi is still answering your last question.

title.update_plan: Koutsi has drafted a change to your plan
title.update_workout: Koutsi has drafted a change to a session

proposal.nothingYet: Nothing has changed yet. This happens only if you accept it.
proposal.archiveTitle: Accepting will archive {count} of your plans
proposal.archiveUndo: You can bring an archived plan back from the plan page.
proposal.reopens: Accepting will reactivate a plan you had finished or filed away.
proposal.ruleBased: Koutsi's own planner drafted these weeks — its AI model couldn't be reached for this one.

status.applied: You accepted this — it is live.
status.declined: You left things as they were.
status.expired: This offer expired without an answer.
status.superseded: Koutsi replaced this with a later suggestion.

errors.expired: That offer has expired. Ask Koutsi again and it will draft a fresh one.
errors.decided: You have already answered that one.
errors.stale: Your plans have changed since Koutsi drafted that, so it would no longer do what the card said. Ask Koutsi again.

proposal.stranded: This shortens the plan, and {count} planned session(s) fall past its new last day. They are not deleted, and they will still count as missed — clear those days yourself if you don't want them scored.
